```{python}
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

gold = L.xlsx("zloty_zbior_do_oznaczenia.xlsx")
lem = L.xlsx("ocena_lematyzacji_300.xlsx")
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
filled = lambda s: int(s.notna().sum())
```

```{python}
L.table([
    ("Gold set", "are the model labels (T1, T2, T3 …) right?",
     f"{n(len(gold))} candidates with sentences, no model labels shown; two annotators",
     f"A {n(filled(gold['kategoria_oceniajacy_A']))}, B {n(filled(gold['kategoria_oceniajacy_B']))} of {n(len(gold))}",
     "`zloty_zbior_oznaczony.xlsx`, then re-run step 6"),
    ("Lemmatisation", "which tool gives the right base form?",
     f"{n(len(lem))} inflected forms in context with the answer of every tool",
     f"{n(filled(lem['lemat_poprawny_czlowiek']))} of {n(len(lem))}",
     "`ocena_lematyzacji_300_sprawdzone.xlsx`, then re-run step 2"),
], ["Worksheet", "Question", "Content", "Filled in", "Save as"], "lllll")
```

Download a file, fill it in, save it under the given name next to the original. The pipeline then reports accuracy
against it.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Gold set

Equal numbers per final label, half from cases the models agreed on and half from adjudicated ones, shuffled.
Definitions of the labels are in the second tab of the file (in Polish).

```{python}
L.source("zloty_zbior_do_oznaczenia.xlsx")
L.glossary(gold.columns)
L.dt(gold, page=25, wrap=["zdanie_1", "zdanie_2", "zdanie_3"])
```

## Lemmatisation (300 forms)

Fill in `lemat_poprawny_czlowiek` and `pos_poprawny_czlowiek`.

```{python}
L.source("ocena_lematyzacji_300.xlsx")
L.glossary(lem.columns)
L.dt(lem, page=25, wrap=["kontekst"], hide=[c for c in lem.columns if c.endswith("_pos")])
```

:::
